data.name: Freeborn
data.long_meaning: Derived from Old English 'frēo' (free) and 'born' (born). The name Freeborn signifies one who is born free, unencumbered, and unbound by the restrictions of society or circumstances. This name is a reminder of the spiritual freedom that comes from faith in God.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolic of the spiritual freedom found in faith.
data.numerology_meaning: People with the life path number 5 are natural rebels, free thinkers, and adventurers. They love to explore and learn new things. Freeborn is a name that embodies this spirit of freedom and curiosity.
